extension.description: A high-performance PDF previewer for VS Code powered by EmbedPDF 3.x and PDFium WebAssembly. Fast, interactive, and works on Desktop & Web.
configuration.title: Modern PDF Preview
configuration.defaultZoomLevel.descripti: The initial zoom level when opening a PDF file.
configuration.defaultSpreadMode.descript: The initial spread mode when opening a PDF file.
configuration.tabBar.description: Control the visibility of the internal viewer tab bar.
configuration.worker.description: Run PDF rendering in a Web Worker using a blob-backed bypass in VS Code webviews, falling back to the main thread if unavailable.
configuration.enableForms.description: Allow filling interactive PDF form fields inside the preview.
configuration.showStatusBar.description: Show current PDF page, zoom level, and open PDF tab count in the VS Code status bar.
command.forceSave.title: Save PDF
